aabb_union_note: swept_aabb_union spans the robot base through the enclosure; its volume exceeds the enclosure so it is not a keep-out shape. A0e uses occupancy voxels plus per-link AABBs of links that enter the enclosure (link5/6/7, hand, fingers, cup).

link_occupancy_per_geom_union.note: Keep-out for A0e: voxels overlapping any per-geom AABB, not the per-link hull.

link_occupancy_union.note: AABB union is a hull of the whole motion including the base; occupancy voxels inside the enclosure are the keep-out for A0e

sensor_config.engagement_model: nearest clutter AABB point in the sensor frustum (half-angle = fov/2) and Euclidean distance <= clip_far_m
